about.title:
Logistics expertise,
evolving *since 1983*
about.lead: Namma began in 1983 with relocation services. Today, we deliver integrated logistics and supply chain solutions: freight management, transportation, warehousing, distribution and customs clearance for enterprise and industrial customers across Saudi Arabia and the GCC.
body: Four decades of operating in the Kingdom have built our understanding of its ports, borders, regulations and project sites, and how complex cargo moves through them.
That experience, combined with certified management systems and an international partner network, supports reliable operations for the businesses we serve.

process.title:
The end-to-end
*logistics journey*
process.intro: One partner from the first document to final delivery. Each stage connects to the next, with visibility and coordination maintained throughout.
lines: Paperwork is checked and prepared before anything moves.
Your cargo is collected straight from the factory.
Packed and crated to suit the journey ahead.
Cleared for export and handled at the port of loading.
Booked on the right vessel or flight for the main leg.
Carried on by road, rail or sea, as the route requires.
Cleared on arrival and released from the port.
Stored, prepared and dispatched when you need it.
Delivered to your door, site or warehouse.

projectLogistics.title:
Complex cargo requires
*planning from the start*
body: Moving heavy equipment and oversized cargo involves more than simply choosing a mode of transport.

Cargo dimensions and weight, routing, ports, handling methods and site access requirements are all considered before movement begins. Namma provides project logistics solutions from initial planning through to the shipment’s arrival at the project site.

journey.title: Transport & Handling
journey.body: Selecting transport and handling methods suited to the equipment or cargo.

journey.title: Port Operations
journey.body: Coordinating loading, unloading and handling operations associated with the shipment’s movement through the port.

journey.title: Site Delivery
journey.body: Coordinating the final stage of the journey until the equipment reaches the project site.

heavyBody: Some equipment and machinery cannot be moved using conventional methods because of their dimensions or weight.
In these cases, cargo and route requirements are assessed to select suitable transport and handling methods for delivery to the destination.
handlingBody: Some equipment requires specialized transport, lifting and handling methods.
Requirements are determined by the cargo’s dimensions, weight and characteristics, with loading, transport and unloading coordinated through to the delivery site.

airFreight.title:
Air freight for
*time-critical* cargo
body: When the arrival date leads, air freight moves your cargo on scheduled services or, when capacity or timing demands it, on a dedicated charter.
Namma arranges the booking, documentation and handling at both ends, and connects the flight with customs clearance and delivery in Saudi Arabia.

included.body: Space booked on airline services that match the route and the required arrival date.

included.title: Air charter
included.body: Dedicated capacity when cargo dimensions, weight or timing do not fit scheduled services.

seaFreight.title:
Sea freight for
*full containers and
project cargo*
body: Sea freight carries full containers, breakbulk and project cargo between international ports and Saudi Arabia, port to port or door to door.
Namma books the carrier, prepares the documents and coordinates the land legs, port handling and customs clearance on both sides.

LCL shipments:
*share the container*

Namma coordinates consolidation at origin, the sea leg, and deconsolidation, clearance and delivery at destination.

included.title: Consolidation
included.body: Your cargo is combined with other shipments in a shared container at origin.

included.title: Volume-based space
included.body: Space is arranged around the volume and weight of the cargo that is moving.

included.title: Deconsolidation
included.body: Cargo is separated from the shared container after arrival.

included.title: Onward delivery

customs-officer.title: Customs Officer
customs-officer.about: As Customs Officer in Jeddah, you make sure our customers’ import and export shipments clear smoothly by reviewing documents, preparing declarations and working with Saudi customs and the relevant authorities to release goods without delay.
responsibilities: Review commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin and other shipping documents.
Prepare and submit customs declarations through the national customs platform.
Classify goods under the correct HS codes and calculate duties and fees.
Follow up inspections and releases at Jeddah Islamic Port and King Abdulaziz International Airport.
Coordinate requirements with relevant authorities such as SFDA and SASO.
Keep customers and the operations team updated on clearance status.
qualifications: Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Logistics or a related field.
Good knowledge of Saudi customs procedures, tariff classification and documentation.
Experience with the national customs platform and clearance workflows.
